text:
Iris: quick thought from the nav regroup: when someone lands on a deep-link like /org/green/workspace/12/models/xyz, should the nav silently reveal the Models group and highlight the item, or visibly animate and move keyboard focus? trying to balance orientation vs scroll/viewport jumps.
Omar: prefer reveal + focus. if the item is hidden its confusing for assistive tech. aria-expanded on group, aria-current on item.
June: agree accessibility-first, but user experience matter: if we force focus the page might scroll and disorient. idea: reveal group, set aria-live politely, then focus the item with preventScroll. e.g.:
```js
// on mount from router
expandGroup('models');
const el = document.getElementById('nav-model-xyz');
el?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
el?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
```
Ben: +1. also we should surface that the UI changed because of a link. small ephemeral banner: "Opened via link  Models expanded" with an undo ("Collapse") action so users can restore previous collapsed state.
Iris: good point about undo. what about users who manually collapsed it earlier? should deep-links override stored manual preference?
Omar: deep-link is explicit intent. override on initial navigation, but remember manual toggles going forward in user prefs/localStorage. so: first load -> override; manual collapse -> persist.
June: a11y details: set tabindex="-1" on the selected item so focusable without altering tab order. use aria-current="page" and ensure screen readers announce breadcrumbs separately. consider role="navigation" with nested lists instead of role=tree to avoid complex keyboard trapping.
Ben: animation note  animate the expand with a short 120ms slide + fade so users get a visual cue. ensure prefers-reduced-motion respected.
QA-Bot: added checklist item A11Y-221 "deep-link reveal, focus, and undo toast" to the regression suite.
Omar: routing: router should translate canonical path -> nav state on mount (no query hacks). keep URLs clean for sharing. maybe also expose a small state param when coming from an external referrer so we can show the toast only for external loads.
Iris: keyboard flow to verify in the PR: Tab into left nav -> ArrowDown to group header -> RightArrow or Enter expands -> ArrowDown reaches item -> focus is set on item (preventScroll) -> Enter navigates. test with NVDA + VoiceOver.
June: action items: (1) router mount hook to expand+select (Omar), (2) focus+preventScroll + scrollIntoView nearest (June), (3) ephemeral "Opened via link" toast with Undo that persists manual state (Ben), (4) update Figma and include keyboard gif + reduced-motion variant (Iris), (5) add a11y regression checks (QA-Bot).
Iris: I'll update Figma + add a short prototype showing the animation and toast. will open PR and tag folks. thanks! :sparkles:
